info.name: Public Api v3 Applicant Bank Account Lookup Verification API

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of items count to retrieve.

items.docs:
Returns the list of all Bank Account Lookup Verifications within your organization.
You can limit the number of items returned by using filters and pagination.
Consult our [guide](https://developers.yousign.com/docs/bank-account-lookup-verification) for more details and examples.

info.name: Initiate a new Bank Account Lookup Verification

items.docs:
Initiate a new Bank Account Lookup Verification to check if a bank account exists and belongs to the specified person or company.

Related guide: [Bank Account Verification](https://developers.yousign.com/docs/bank-account-lookup-verification)
